# Subway Seat for Gogh

Gogh themes: the 16 ANSI colours, background, foreground and cursor. The YAML is what Gogh's themes/ folder takes; the JSON matches its generated data/json files.

[Gogh](https://github.com/Gogh-Co/Gogh) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/gogh/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`Subway Seat.yml`](Subway%20Seat.yml) | Gogh/themes/Subway Seat.yml |
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.json`](subway-seat.json) | Gogh/data/json/subway-seat.json |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`Subway Seat Tunnel.yml`](Subway%20Seat%20Tunnel.yml) | Gogh/themes/Subway Seat Tunnel.yml |

| Subway Seat Enamel | [`Subway Seat Enamel.yml`](Subway%20Seat%20Enamel.yml) | Gogh/themes/Subway Seat Enamel.yml |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.json`](subway-seat-enamel.json) | Gogh/data/json/subway-seat-enamel.json |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in a Gogh checkout: the YAML is its theme source (the file name must match the name):

```sh
cp "Subway Seat.yml" Gogh/themes/
cd Gogh && task validate
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in a Gogh checkout: the YAML is its theme source (the file name must match the name):

```sh
cp "Subway Seat Tunnel.yml" Gogh/themes/
cd Gogh && task validate
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in a Gogh checkout: the YAML is its theme source (the file name must match the name):

```sh
cp "Subway Seat Enamel.yml" Gogh/themes/
cd Gogh && task validate
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
